recentItems.title: Anti-migrant agitator Daniel Thomas - aka ‘Danny Tommo’ - arrested
recentItems.description:
The anti-migrant agitator Daniel Thomas - also known as Danny Tommo - has been arrested after a video appeared to show him slashing a dinghy, with an emergency responder on board. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Hampshire Police said a 37-year-old man was detained Wednesday night on suspicion of destroying ships and criminal damage with intent to endanger life.

His arrest came on a day when the UK recorded the highest number of migrants arriving on a single day so far this year - though numbers are 42% lower than at this point in 2025.

recentItems.title: Ethiopia at war: is one of the world’s deadliest conflicts reigniting?
recentItems.description:
Ethiopia is in danger of being plunged back into civil war as rebel forces in the north seize three airports and attack government forces.

People in the country’s northern Tigray region are stocking up on food, cash and other supplies, fearing war is about to break out again. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Hundreds of thousands of people were killed in a two-year war between Tigrayan forces and Ethiopia's government, which ended with a peace deal in 2022.

Now Tigrayan and forces allied with them have made significant advances in the state and attacked two neighbouring regions, saying they are countering aggression by the government.

recentItems.title: Trump and Xi meet as US and China battle for AI supremacy
recentItems.description:
At the pinnacle of super power: Donald Trump welcomed China’s President Xi Jinping at the White House, with everything from war, the global economy to AI on the agenda - and with those, possibly the future of humanity.

Whatever the two presidents may decide in the next day or two, one message was unmistakable: when you get to the pinnacle of raw power on this earth there are only two people in the room - one of them is American, and one of them is Chinese. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Trump's first presidency was marked by hostility to China, but his second, despite some of the rhetoric, has seen much more conciliatory actions. 

The Chinese president brought the promise of pandas, two for the Atlanta Zoo, but critics here say President Trump brought the pandering. 

It leaves big questions, is America a declining power, is China going to surpass it, and what does that mean for the world?

recentItems.title: Donald Trump meets Xi Jinping - new balance of POWER?
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: World is in 'age of impunity' says David Miliband
recentItems.description:
Former UK foreign secretary David Miliband has told Channel 4 News that the world was now in an "age of impunity".

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Mr Miliband - now Head of the International Rescue Committee - was speaking after war loomed over the UN General Assembly this week as Iran responded to President Donald Trump weighing up its annihilation during his speech.

President Emmanuel Macron had said international institutions were losing out to the law of the jungle at the moment.
